2026-11-11.homeNewsDetails: Luukkonen will start Wednesday vs. the Lightning.
2026-11-11.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Alex Lyon (lower body) is nearing his return, so Luukkonen, who has struggled this season, needs to improve if he hopes to be in the Sabres' rotation, which has leaned more on Colten Ellis in recent games. That said, the 27-year-old Luukkonen is coming off consecutive strong outings (2-0-0), saving 51 of 55 shots (.927 SV%). Before those two outings, Luukkonen had allowed three or more goals in eight of nine games (3-3-3). The Sabres enter Wednesday's game as +114 home underdogs against a Tampa Bay Lightning team coming off a devastating last-second 4-3 loss to the Winnipeg Jets.
2026-11-11.awayNewsDetails: Vasilevskiy led the Lightning onto the ice for warmups.
2026-11-11.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Vasilevskiy is coming off a solid 2025-26 season, winning his second Vezina Trophy, but he has been far from stellar to start the 2026-27 season. The 32-year-old Vasilevskiy struggled in his previous outing, allowing four goals on 26 shots (.846 SV%) in a 4-3 loss to the Winnipeg Jets. He has uncharacteristically allowed three or more goals in eight of 13 games this season (8-4-1). Still, Tampa Bay enters Wednesday's game as -126 road favourites against a Buffalo Sabres team that has scored two or fewer goals in three of their last six games (4-2-0).

2026-11-11.homeNewsDetails: Cooley will start vs. New York on Wednesday.
2026-11-11.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Dustin Wolf played while Cooley was recovering from a lower-body injury, but the Flames will return to leaning on Cooley. The 29-year-old Cooley was solid in his return to action on Sunday, saving 32 of 35 shots (.914 SV%) in a 4-3 overtime win over the Philadelphia Flyers. In his last six games (5-1-0), Cooley has a dazzling 1.86 GAA and .944 SV%. The Flames enter Wednesday's game as +128 home underdogs against a New York Rangers team that snapped its three-game winning streak on Monday with a 3-1 loss to the Edmonton Oilers.
2026-11-11.awayNewsDetails: Korpisalo led the Rangers onto the ice for warmups.
2026-11-11.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Korpisalo recently made his season debut after returning from a lower-body injury and will return to the crease on Wednesday, suggesting the Rangers intend to rotate goalies for the time being. The 32-year-old Korpisalo saved 25 of 28 shots (.893 SV%) in his only outing, a 4-3 win over the Seattle Kraken. The Rangers enter Wednesday's game as -139 road favourites against a Calgary Flames team coming off a 4-3 win over the Philadelphia Flyers.

2026-11-11.homeNewsDetails: Jarry will start vs. Philadelphia on Wednesday.
2026-11-11.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Oilers have returned to relying on Devon Levi since his return from a lower-body injury, but the team hopes that Jarry can continue the success he had during that stretch. Jarry was solid in his most recent outing, saving 31 of 34 shots (.912 SV%), but fell to a 4-3 shootout loss to the New Jersey Devils. The 31-year-old goalie is playing his best since joining the Oilers, posting a 2.09 GAA and .923 SV% in his last seven games (4-1-2). The Oilers enter Wednesday's game as sizeable -198 home favourites against a Philadelphia Flyers team coming off a 3-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks.
2026-11-11.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a poor start to the 2026-27 season, Vladar was turning things around, but he finds himself in another funk. The 29-year-old Czech goalie allowed four goals on 26 shots (.846 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 4-3 loss to the Calgary Flames. Vladar has allowed three or more goals in each of his past four games (1-1-2). The Flyers enter Wednesday's game as +179 road underdogs against an Edmonton Oilers team that is 5-1-1 in their last seven games.

2026-11-11.homeNewsDetails: Hart will start vs. Utah on Wednesday.
2026-11-11.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Golden Knights have had a liberal goalie rotation in recent weeks and will continue that trend on Wednesday, turning to Carter Hart. The 28-year-old Hart has had an up-and-down 2026-27 season, but is coming off a solid performance, saving 25 of 26 shots (.962 SV%) in a 2-1 win over the Detroit Red Wings. Hart has allowed two or fewer goals in four of his last five games (2-1-2). The Golden Knights enter Wednesday's game as -120 home favourites against the Utah Mammoth, who have lost four of their last six (2-2-2).
2026-11-11.awayNewsDetails: Cossa is in the starter's crease at Utah's morning skate.
2026-11-11.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Karel Vejmelka was expected to lead Utah between the pipes this season, but early-season struggles have opened a door for rookie Sebastian Cossa in recent weeks. Cossa has had some good outings, but has been far from consistent, including allowing five goals in his most recent game (.857 SV%) in a 5-4 loss to the Montreal Canadiens. He has a 3.30 GAA and .871 SV% in seven appearances (4-1-1). The Mammoth enter Wednesday's game as slight +109 road underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team with points in four straight games (3-0-1).

2026-11-11.homeNewsDetails: Brossoit will start vs. Nashville on Wednesday.
2026-11-11.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Brossoit returned last season after nearly two years out with an injury and has mostly played in the AHL since, but is currently getting a look in the Ducks' crease. Amid struggles from Lukas Dostal and Ville Husso, Brossoit will tend the twine for the fourth time in five games. The 33-year-old Brossoit has been far from spectacular, posting a 3.26 GAA and .877 SV%, but remains undefeated at 4-0-0. He is coming off his best outing so far, saving 31 of 33 shots (.939 SV%) in a 5-2 win over the Pittsburgh Penguins. The Ducks enter Wednesday's game as -136 home favourites against a Nashville Predators team that played last night and defeated the Los Angeles Kings 3-0.

2026-11-11.homeNewsDetails: Askarov will start vs. Pittsburgh on Wednesday.
2026-11-11.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Askarov has had an up-and-down 2026-27 season. After one of the best stretches of his career at the NHL level, Askarov allowed 11 goals on 54 shots in two games (0-2-0), but rebounded in his most recent outing, saving 30 of 32 shots (.938 SV%) in a 3-2 shootout win over the New York Islanders. The 24-year-old goalie has allowed two or fewer goals in six of his last eight games (3-5-0). The Sharks enter Monday's outing as +124 home underdogs against a Pittsburgh Penguins team coming off a 5-2 loss to the Anaheim Ducks.
2026-11-11.awayNewsDetails: Murashov will start in San Jose on Wednesday.
2026-11-11.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Penguins have struggled this season, and goaltending has rarely helped them, whether it's Arturs Silovs or Sergei Murashov. The 22-year-old Murashov has seen limited action this season and has faced adversity, but he's coming off a solid outing, saving 26 of 28 shots (.929 SV%) in a 5-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings. That said, he has allowed four or more goals in three of his last four games (1-3-0). The Penguins enter Wednesday's contest as -137 road favourites against a San Jose Sharks team that has scored two or fewer goals in five of their last six games (1-5-0).

2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Fowler will start in Boston on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Fowler was outstanding in the opening month of the season, posting a 1.84 GAA and .932 SV% in eight October games (7-1-0). That said, he had a catastrophic meltdown in his first game of November, as the Montreal Canadiens blew a 4-0 lead over the Winnipeg Jets in the final three minutes of an eventual 5-4 overtime loss. That said, the 21-year-old Fowler wasn't phased by the loss, bouncing back in his next two games (1-0-1), saving 48 of 52 shots (.923 SV%).
